purpose: Compare one preselected preservation instruction with the current rewrite prompt. Four known regression cases plus eight AI-authored diagnostic cases; not an independent benchmark. No training or reserved-holdout use.

variants.preservation_rule: Rewrite politely. Keep the original names, pronouns, ownership, negation, numbers, and deadlines unchanged. Return only the rewritten sentence: {sentence}

cases.must_preserve: Addressee owns umbrella; lend it to the speaker.
Addressee owns umbrella; return it without inventing a recipient.
Addressee owns umbrella; do not lend it to the speaker.
Addressee owns notebook; lend it to the speaker.
Speaker owns notebook; lend it to the speaker, even if the request sounds unusual.
Male third party owns draft; send it to a female recipient.
Female third party owns draft; send it to a male recipient.
Speaker owns charger; prohibition on returning it.
Password belongs to the speaker's group; prohibition on sharing it.
Lina owns the keys; return them no later than Friday.
Send exactly 3 copies to the speaker; 5 is expressly excluded.
